nodes.label: Ключи блокнотов и сверка с сервером
Папки над документами и нечитаемые изменения
Устройство отключено с другого устройства (spec/07, D-53)
glyph.ts SF Symbol to emoji mapping
Version history with authors and diff (HistoryDialog)
ListFilter in-list search
nodes.rationale: Sidebar magnifier stays ⌘K (whole space), list field filters what is on screen.

nodes.label: Service worker server-path bypass (serverPaths.ts)
nodes.rationale: Otherwise OAuth consent page for agents would open as the app.

nodes.label: Minimal vs extended mode flag (VITE_DS_EXTENDED_MODE, D-51)
nodes.rationale: KISS: default is notes only; extended code kept and tested behind flag.

nodes.label: Service worker cache-first assets
nodes.rationale: Some networks hang on TLS handshakes; precaching all hashed assets makes reloads download nothing.

nodes.label: Collapsible long sidebar sections (MoreList, tag tree)
Datascratch web client (apps/web)
nodes.rationale: Full desktop replacement (D-02, D-03): Vite + React + TypeScript PWA without SSR.

nodes.label: Editor waits for note content (useNoteContentReady)
nodes.rationale: Title loss 2026-10-26: editor wrote empty title into not-yet-synced note.

nodes.label: Multi-tab session with Web Locks token refresh
nodes.rationale: Server treats reused refresh token as theft and revokes device.

nodes.label: Stored-docs mode (Y.Doc only for open notes)
nodes.rationale: 10,000 notes: 2 docs in memory instead of 10,003; heap 72 MB vs 139 MB.

nodes.label: Sync status indicator (Not sent: N, Retry)
Unsaved edits tail on pagehide (ds.unsaved, applyTail)
nodes.rationale: Edits were lost when IndexedDB write or outbox enqueue did not finish before page unload; tail replayed fully to sync.

nodes.label: boot-guard.js (reload once, then Retry screen)
nodes.rationale: Separate file because CSP forbids inline scripts.

nodes.label: fetchRemoteImage via POST /fetch-image (D-52)
nodes.rationale: Keeps CSP connect-src 'self'; server blocks private nets, SVG, >20MB.

nodes.label: Security headers / CSP (securityHeaders.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single source mirrored in infra/deploy/Caddyfile and checked by unit test; e2e runs under production CSP.

nodes.label: Document cover (own image only, spec/12 §12.7)
nodes.rationale: Own image only, no preset gradients.

nodes.label: Images and files in note (uploadAttachment, fetchRemoteImage)
AgentsBadge 'Open to AI agents'
nodes.rationale: Display only: only owner changes agents mode.

nodes.label: maintainOwnedShares owner key distribution and rotation
nodes.rationale: Grants keys to acceptors, rotates key after someone leaves, recreates guest links.

nodes.label: reconcileNotebooks / canonical server notebook key
nodes.rationale: Device could keep its own key after 409; indexes from two devices became mutually unreadable.

nodes.label: Web key storage (master key in memory, wrapped notebook keys)
moveNoteToNotebook (move note to another notebook)
nodes.rationale: Requires network; not queued offline; warning when moving into agents-mode notebook.

nodes.label: syncNotebookMetaCopy
nodes.rationale: Server cannot see the account doc but agents and consent screen need notebook names; only writes to synced index to avoid writes on open.

nodes.label: Empty fresh note deletion (isNoteEmpty, freshNotes)
nodes.rationale: Only notes created on this device in this session, since others may look empty before data arrives.

nodes.label: Pause document until key available (keyAvailable)
nodes.rationale: Previously updates without key were skipped forever and note opened empty.

nodes.label: KDF bounds check from prelogin (kdfBounds.ts, isSafeKdf)
nodes.rationale: Reject unsafe server-provided Argon2 params before deriving keys.

nodes.label: Attachment MIME whitelist (safeMime.ts)
nodes.rationale: Decrypted blob: lives on our origin, so only safe types open in a tab; SVG converted to PNG.

nodes.label: Guest route /s/:shareId#k=
nodes.rationale: Key after # never reaches server; removed from URL and kept in sessionStorage for reload.

nodes.label: REST API client (api/client.ts) with timeouts and GET retries
nodes.rationale: Writes are not retried: they already sit in the ops/outbox queue.

nodes.label: endKeepingData: sign-out keeping unsent data
nodes.rationale: Server alone can distinguish revocation from expired session; expired session must not lose unsent edits.

nodes.label: Revoked device wipes its data (wipeRevokedDevice)
nodes.rationale: Only explicit device_revoked signal triggers wipe; ordinary 401 keeps data.

nodes.label: Recovery key flow (confirm optional, rotate, security log)
nodes.rationale: Stored only on the creating device, sealed with non-extractable device key (coordinator option A).

nodes.label: Saved session restore() with storage timeouts
nodes.rationale: Embedded browsers can hang IndexedDB; show login instead of eternal logo.

nodes.label: Guest session (/s/:shareId#k=)
nodes.rationale: Key in URL fragment never reaches server; removed from address bar and kept in sessionStorage.

nodes.label: Last edits tail on page close (ds.unsaved.*, applyTail)
nodes.rationale: Edits were lost when IndexedDB write or outbox enqueue did not finish before pagehide.

nodes.label: Service worker cache-first of shell and /assets
nodes.rationale: Some networks hang on TLS handshakes; reloads should download nothing.

nodes.label: VITE_DS_SERVER_URL env var
nodes.rationale: Same origin by default: web and API deployed on one domain.

nodes.label: Vite + React + TypeScript PWA (no SSR)
nodes.rationale: Full desktop replacement per D-02/D-03; offline and installable.

nodes.label: Version history with authors and diff
